mail-intake.subject: Medicaid plan contract + telehealth expansion: need counsel by Nov 20
mail-intake.body:
Hello,

I'm General Counsel at Northlake Behavioral Health. We provide virtual outpatient mental health and substance use treatment, and we're growing fast.

Two things we need help with:

1. Hudson Valley Health Plan, a New York Medicaid managed care plan, sent us its participating provider agreement. They want it signed by November 20 so we go live January 1. We need a review and a redline: rates, credentialing timelines, termination, and whatever Medicaid managed care rules require.

2. We're expanding telehealth into six states next year: New York, New Jersey, California, Illinois, Texas and Florida. We need a licensure and prescribing analysis for each (including controlled substances for our MAT program), plus a look at our 42 CFR Part 2 consent form and our BAA template.

Can Manatt take this on? Our outside counsel guidelines are attached.

Priya

mail-engagement.subject: RE: Engagement letter - Northlake (61407-002)
mail-engagement.body:
Rosa,

Signed letter attached. Our outside counsel guidelines apply, as we discussed. Please send invoices monthly to legalops@northlakebh.example.

Priya

quote.subject: Engagement letter - Northlake (61407-002)
quote.text:
Priya,

The engagement letter for the HVHP agreement and the telehealth work is attached. Rates are our 2026 health system panel rates. Sign and send it back when you can.

Rosa

mail-kestrel-ocg.subject: Kestrel Valley Health billing guidelines (2026)
mail-kestrel-ocg.body:
Rosa,

Attached are our updated billing guidelines for outside counsel. The main changes for 2026:
- partner time capped at $995 an hour
- calls over 0.5 hours need our approval
- each entry starts with its activity code

They apply to invoices from February 1.

Thanks,
Marisol

mail-agenda.subject: Kickoff agenda (61407-002)
mail-agenda.body:
Rosa,

For our kickoff. Marcus is joining, he owns the go-live.

Our list, roughly in order:
- the rate exhibit. HVHP's numbers are below what we get from Riverbend
- credentialing. they say 120 days, we can't wait that long for Jan 1
- can they really terminate without cause on 60 days?
- which states first. board wants NY and NJ in Q1, the rest after

Priya

mail-hvhp.subject: FW: HVHP participating provider agreement v3 (61407-002)
mail-hvhp.body:
Rosa,

Here's the latest from Janet at HVHP. They're calling v3 final. I don't buy it, especially on credentialing.

Can you look before our 9:15?

Marcus

quote.subject: HVHP participating provider agreement v3
quote.text:
Marcus,

Attached is v3 of the Participating Provider Agreement with the changes we discussed. We would need signature by 11/20 for a 1/1 effective date.

Thanks,
Janet Okoye
Provider Contracting | Hudson Valley Health Plan

mail-theo.subject: matrix (61407-002)
mail-theo.body:
Rosa,

First pass at the Northlake matrix is attached. Columns are what we said on the call:
- licensure
- interstate compact
- DEA
- state controlled substance rules
- Part 2 notes

All six states have a first pass. I'd start with NY and NJ since they go first.

One flag on NY: the MAT side needs OASAS certification, not just the OMH telehealth approval. I put it in the NY row.

Theo

mail-summary.subject: RE: Medicaid plan contract + telehealth expansion: need counsel by Nov 20
mail-summary.body:
Priya,

Where we are after today:

HVHP agreement. Redline is attached. Main asks: rates in Exhibit B up to your Riverbend numbers, credentialing in 60 days with provisional status after that, and no termination without cause in year one. The 42 CFR 438 terms they left out are in now too. Once you're fine with it I'll send it to Janet.

States. Theo's matrix covers all six. NY and NJ go first, then CA, IL, TX and FL. Prescribing for the MAT program is in the same chart.

Part 2 consent and BAA. Comments on both coming early next week. The consent form is still on the old language and the 2024 rule is in force now, so it needs updating.

Talk soon,
Rosa

mail-invite-kickoff.note: Rosa, sending a Teams link for the kickoff. Agenda to follow.

mail-invite-theo.subject: Rosa / Theo: Northlake licensure matrix (61407-002)

mail-theo-reply.subject: RE: matrix (61407-002)
mail-theo-reply.body:
Done. NJ CDS registration is in the state CS column of the NJ row now, apart from the DEA side.

Question for Priya at some point: does Northlake have DEA registrations in all six states already, or just NY?

Theo

Looks good. Pull NJ CDS out as its own step, it's not the same as DEA.

R

lines.text: OK, Marcus is on. Rosa, rates first? That's the one the board asks about.
Sure. Exhibit B is under what Riverbend pays you for the same codes. We push them up to that.
Credentialing is my problem. A hundred twenty days kills January first.
We ask for sixty, and provisional credentialing after that so you can see members.
And the without cause termination. Sixty days notice is nothing.
I'd take it out for the first year. They'll probably come back with ninety days.
States. Board wants New York and New Jersey in Q1.
But I need all six mapped before the December board meeting. California and Texas matter for next year's numbers.
Fine. Theo does the matrix, all six, with the controlled substance rules for MAT.
Great. Send me where we are end of day?
One row per state. Licensure, compact, prescribing, Part 2 notes.
Do you want DEA and state CS rules split? It gets messy otherwise.
Split them. You take NY and NJ first, then the rest.

clientRulebooks.title: Northlake Behavioral Health Outside Counsel Guidelines (2026)

rules.title: Engagement-letter rates
rules.quote: Timekeepers are paid at the rates in the engagement letter. Higher rates on an invoice are reduced.
rules.does: Bills R. Delacroix at the engagement-letter rate, $1,075 an hour.

rules.title: Approved timekeepers only
rules.quote: Only timekeepers approved in the engagement letter may bill time to Northlake matters.
rules.does: Checks each line's timekeeper against the approved list: R. Delacroix and T. Navarro.

rules.title: Tenth-hour increments
rules.quote: Time is recorded in increments of one-tenth of an hour.
rules.does: Rounds each entry's recorded minutes up to the next tenth of an hour.

rules.title: One task per entry
rules.quote: Each time entry must describe a single task. Block-billed entries will be returned.
rules.does: Splits a block-billed entry into one line per task, each with the time Time Capture recorded for that task.

rules.title: No vague narratives
rules.quote: Entries such as "review file", "attention to matter", "call" or "email" without the subject and the other party are not paid.
rules.does: Checks that each narrative names the task, the people and the subject. A bare note such as "phone call with client" fails.

rules.title: Counseling code first
rules.quote: Each entry begins with its UTBMS counseling code (C100 to C400).
rules.does: Puts each entry's counseling code in front of its narrative, for example "C300".

rules.title: Internal conferences are not paid
rules.quote: Conferences between firm attorneys or staff are firm overhead and will not be paid.
rules.does: Keeps a conference between firm people on the bill at no charge.

rules.title: One attendee per meeting
rules.quote: Only one timekeeper may bill for a meeting or call unless Northlake approves more attendees in advance.
rules.does: Checks that only one Manatt timekeeper billed each meeting.

rules.title: Research over 2.0 hours needs approval
rules.quote: Legal research over 2.0 hours on a single issue requires Northlake's prior written approval.
rules.does: Checks each research line against the 2.0-hour limit.

rules.title: No clerical time
rules.quote: Clerical and administrative work, such as filing, copying, scheduling and organizing files, is not billable.
rules.does: Checks each narrative for clerical work.

rules.title: Travel at 50%
rules.quote: Non-working travel time is billed at 50% of the timekeeper's rate.
rules.does: Bills travel time at half rate when there is any.

rules.title: Intake is not billed
rules.quote: We will not charge for the initial consultation, new matter intake, our conflicts review or the preparation of this letter.
rules.does: Bills intake, the conflicts review and the first consultation at no charge.

clientRulebooks.title: Kestrel Valley Health Billing Guidelines for Outside Counsel (2026)

rules.title: Partner rate cap
rules.quote: Partner time is paid at no more than $995 per hour in 2026.
rules.does: Bills R. Delacroix at $995 an hour.

rules.title: Tenth-hour increments
rules.quote: Bill in tenths of an hour.
rules.does: Rounds each entry's recorded minutes up to the next tenth of an hour.

rules.title: Time for each task
rules.quote: An entry may list more than one task only if the time for each task appears in parentheses after it.
rules.does: Keeps the research and matrix entry on one line and writes in each task's time from Time Capture: (0.7) and (0.9).

rules.title: Activity code first
rules.quote: Begin each entry with its UTBMS activity code (A101 to A111).
rules.does: Puts each entry's activity code in front of its narrative, for example "A106".

rules.title: Calls up to 0.5 hours
rules.quote: Telephone and video calls are paid up to 0.5 hours each unless Kestrel approves a longer call in writing.
rules.does: Cuts a call over 0.5 hours to 0.5 hours.

rules.title: Internal conferences: senior attendee only
rules.quote: For a conference between firm lawyers, only the most senior attendee may bill.
rules.does: Keeps the conference with T. Navarro billable for R. Delacroix, the senior attendee.

rules.title: Research over 3.0 hours needs approval
rules.quote: Research over 3.0 hours on one question needs written approval before the work starts.
rules.does: Checks each research line against the 3.0-hour limit.
